lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，十字眼闪烁。
移动时十字眼忽明忽暗。

lines.en: Stare at the gap in the door.
It drags its feet across the bone wastes.
It skirts the cracks of the flesh plains.
Stare at the cracks in the ground.
Stare at the shadows in the corner.

lines.zh: 十字眼对着火把眨也不眨。
lines.en: Its cross eyes never blink at the torch.

lines.zh: 低头盯着自己发白的手。
lines.en: It stares down at its own pale hands.

lines.zh: 在骨堆旁停住，一动不动。
lines.en: It halts by a bone heap and goes still.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出细小的呜咽。
lines.en: A thin whine rolls in its throat.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，眼里的十字转了一下。
lines.en: I don't blink; the cross in my eyes turns.
Stare at the player, pupils wide.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，喉咙里嘶嘶响。

lines.en: Its cross eyes turn toward your torch.

lines.zh: 它一寸寸挪近，只为吹灭你的灯。
lines.en: It inches closer just to snuff out your lamp.

lines.zh: 你举火把，它眯起十字眼。
lines.en: You raise a torch; its cross eyes narrow.

lines.zh: 它侧头，像在数你的心跳。
lines.en: It tilts its head as if counting your heartbeats.

lines.zh: 十字眼映出你身后的黑暗。
lines.en: Its cross eyes mirror the dark behind you.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，火把微微变暗。
lines.en: It stares, and your torch dims a little.

lines.zh: 它不眨眼，直到你移开视线。
lines.en: It does not blink until you look away.

lines.zh: 它从骨柱后探出半张脸。
lines.en: Half its face slides out from behind a bone pillar.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子看得比你还久。
lines.en: It watches your shadow longer than you.
It backs off, then creeps toward the firelight.

lines.zh: 十字裂开一道，我看不清。
lines.en: A crack splits the cross; I can't see.
One of its cross eyes closes.

lines.zh: 你的光线让我难以忍受！
你不能让我的视线离开！
我的十字眼一睁，火把就灭。
lines.en: My cross eyes open and the torches die.
My eyes will always stare at you!

lines.zh: 你散发的光芒让我不安！
我的视线永远不会移开！
你的身体阻碍了我的视野！

lines.en: My sight is blocked by you!

lines.zh: 你的出现模糊了我的视线！

lines.en: I must clear the sight barrier!

lines.zh: 你的存在让我视线不清！
你的身体挡住我的视线！
另一个游魂在火光那边。
lines.en: Another damned waits by the light.
Keep that lamp lit and stay.

lines.zh: 我必须找到我的另一半！
lines.en: I must find my other half!
Rotting Cross Eyes stare at you!

lines.zh: 你把火把吹灭，我就看得见。
lines.en: Blow out the torch; then I see you.
The fire on you smells good.
I gather this light to my chest.

lines.zh: 它伸手掐灭了你的火把。
lines.en: It reaches out and pinches out your torch.

lines.zh: 我的十字眼已经贴上你了。
lines.en: My cross eyes are fixed on you.

lines.zh: 眼一交叉，你的火把就灭。
lines.en: My eyes cross, and your torch goes out.
Where there's no light, you're mine.
I blew out the fire behind you.
Let me put out your torch first.
The flame moves; its head snaps up.

lines.zh: 它认出了你手里的光源。
lines.en: It has picked out the light in your hand.
You crunch a bone, and it hears.
It turns its face your way.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，它先看见你的灯。
lines.en: In the dark it sees your lamp first.

lines.zh: 十字眼锁定那一小团火。
lines.en: The cross eyes lock on that small flame.

lines.zh: 十字形的瞳孔，盯住光了。
lines.en: My cross-shaped pupils fix on the light.
My cross eyes have locked on you!

lines.zh: 你的火光，我要一盏盏掐灭。
lines.en: I'll snuff every flame you carry.

lines.zh: 我把你的火把全看灭了。
我来了，尝尝我的十字眼！
lines.en: Here I come, taste my cross eyes!
I see you; you don't see me.
Darkness will guide me to you!
I'll end you with my cross eyes!

lines.zh: 它一步一步逼近你的火把。
lines.en: Step by step it closes on your torch.

lines.zh: 它张开手，挡在光和黑暗之间。
lines.en: It spreads its hands between light and dark.
It hisses something under its breath.
It circles your patch of firelight.

lines.zh: 十字眼一眨，黑暗压过来。
lines.en: The cross eyes blink, and the dark presses in.

lines.zh: 它伸手，想把你的灯拧灭。
lines.en: It reaches out to wring your lamp out.

lines.zh: 它盯住你的手腕，那里有光。
lines.en: It fixes on your wrist, where the light is.
It is in no hurry; it will wear your fire down.

lines.zh: 它从阴影里伸出细长的手指。
lines.en: Long fingers reach out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 它在你背后数着你的脚步。
lines.en: It counts your steps behind you.

lines.zh: 你感受到我的凝视了吗？

lines.en: Cross Eyes, see through your soul.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，我的视线如刀锋。
lines.en: In the dark, my gaze is a blade.

lines.zh: 你的世界将被光所吞噬。
lines.en: Your world will be consumed by light.

lines.zh: 光，我的眼中没有你的存在。
灯一盏盏灭，你就该走了。
lines.en: The lamps go out one by one. Time to go.

lines.zh: 十字眼下的你无所遁形。
lines.en: You are nowhere to hide under my cross eyes.

lines.zh: 冰冷的指甲刮过你的手臂。
lines.en: Cold nails rake across your arm.

lines.zh: 它按住你的灯，指缝冒烟。
lines.en: It clamps your lamp; smoke curls from its fingers.

lines.zh: 十字眼贴近，撞进你的视野。
lines.en: The cross eyes shove into your sight.

lines.zh: 它用额头撞你，眼睛却盯着灯。
lines.en: It headbutts you, eyes still on the lamp.

lines.zh: 黑暗顺着它的指尖爬上来。
lines.en: Darkness crawls up from its fingertips.
Wait for you in the shadows.

lines.zh: 十字的眼，在黑里最清楚。
lines.en: Crossed eyes see clearest in the dark.

lines.zh: 骨荒原的沟里，十字眼睁开。
lines.en: In a bone-waste trench, cross eyes open.

lines.zh: 它从血肉平原的褶皱里站起。
lines.en: It rises from a fold of the flesh plains.

lines.zh: 火把照不到的地方，它成形了。
lines.en: Where no torch reaches, it takes shape.

lines.zh: 一口冷气之后，它已在墙角。
lines.en: A breath of cold, and it is in the corner.

lines.zh: 它顺着失落文明的台阶爬上来。
lines.en: It climbs the steps of the lost civilization.

lines.zh: 熄灭的灯旁，它慢慢显形。
lines.en: Beside a dead lamp it slowly appears.
The bone pile stirs, and it crawls out.

lines.zh: 它先睁开眼，才长出身体。
lines.en: First the eyes open, then the body.

lines.zh: 地底的风带来它的嘶声。
lines.en: The underground wind carries its hiss.

lines.zh: 它从基岩裂口下探出头。
lines.en: It pokes its head up through a bedrock crack.
The fire lit up my shadow.
The blast skewed my cross-shaped eyes.

lines.zh: 雷光把我的眼睛照白了...
